trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: story first, then stranger strands, then collectibles and the long grinds, and save the clean-up trophies for last. Track everything here; the progress bar at the top is your platinum meter.
steps: Finish the story and all four chapters
Complete every stranger strand and side activity
Clear the collectibles and the counted grinds
Mop up the missable and moment trophies before the finale

The counter runs across the whole playthrough, so it builds up on its own if you never drive carefully.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy: 'Second time's the charm.' The description points to succeeding on a second attempt — most plausibly retrying something you failed and passing it the second time. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE if it is tied to a specific one-shot moment; more likely it is any retry that succeeds. If you fail a mission or challenge, retry it immediately and pass it — that second-try success is the charm.
steps: If you fail a mission or challenge, retry it right away
Pass it on the second attempt — that is the trophy

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy: 'What the hell just happened?' Something strange to witness — a random event or easter egg in the world. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE if the event is a one-time spawn: keep your eyes open while exploring, especially at odd hours and odd places, and investigate anything strange rather than driving past it.
steps: Explore widely, at different times of day
Investigate strange events instead of driving past them
The trophy pops when you witness the one the game means

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by using a melee weapon — lean out of a moving vehicle and hit someone with a melee weapon. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE only in the sense that it needs a moving vehicle and a target close enough: slow down beside a pedestrian, lean out, and swing. Any moving vehicle and any melee weapon should work.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Drive slowly past a target, lean out and strike with the melee weapon
The drive-by must connect while the vehicle is moving

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy: earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money you clean through contacts — $250,000 in total laundered. Bank robberies and gang operations are the likely source of marked bills; launder them steadily through your contacts rather than hoarding them.

Launder them through your contacts
Reach $250,000 laundered in total

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy: spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending in shops counts — weapons, clothes, food, vehicles, ammo — toward $100,000 total. Spend normally through the playthrough (gear up properly and it climbs on its own); if it lags near the end, buy big-ticket items.

The total across all shops counts toward $100,000
